page.layout: One page of text in a single column; no margin notes, no notes below the text. Running head at top centre; text runs top to bottom with the final line ending short of the margin.

p.i: pem) tum illa comitas, facilitas, humanitas ad quā te lectissimus vir Paulus à Velsperg suo exem plo à pueritia informauit: cuiuf- que nuper nobis specimē cùm hīc apud nos esses, edidisti, vehemen- ter me ad dignitatem tuā aman- dam atque obseruandam incita- uit: vt etiam cùm huic libro Pa- tronus, scriptorum omnium con- sue etudine, quærendus esset, pri- mus mihi cuius illum auctoritati ac patrocinio commendarem, in mentem venires: partim vt splen didissimi nominis tui præsidio tu- tior atque ornatior in manus ho- minum veniret: partim etiam vt aliquod iudicii mei de tuarum virtutum indole testimonii ex- taret

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "consue etudine" appears to be a printing error for "consuetudine" (a space within the word); left as printed. "pem)" at the line start is a fragment carried from the previous page and is kept as a fragment. "cuius" and "specimē", "hīc" and "cùm" are transcribed from the scan with macrons/accents as printed. The first line's opening letters are cut off at the edge of the scan; the fragment is kept as it stands.
